name: Wood Release: Tree Bind Flourishing Burial

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Earth Release, Water Release

system.description:
You manifest a large surge of your vitality, that you then inject into the foliage deep in the ground. Select a point you can see within range on the same surface as yourself. A massive tree, 90-feet tall and 30-feet wide, made of roots, erupts upwards attempting to capture all creatures in its path. This tree counts as an Earthen Artifact.

All creatures whose space would overlap with the tree must make a Strength saving throw, being restrained on a failed save, as the tree captures and binds them inside it. On a successful save, they escape the binding of the tree’s roots.

Creatures who failed the saving throw gain 3 ranks of Drained, have total cover from all creatures both inside and outside the tree and begin to feel immense pressure, as the tree begins to compress and feed off of their biological mass as nutrients. Restrained creatures take 6d8 Earth and Chakra damage at the beginning of each of their turns.

A restrained creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns and must pass their saving throw twice to escape this jutsu’s effects. Alternatively, if the tree takes 100 damage, it is destroyed, freeing all captured creatures.

A creature who’s hit points reach 0 while under the effects of this jutsu becomes a part of the tree.
